feeds.title: Intelligent Yoga Teacher Training
feeds.description: Subscribe us to keep up with the latest Scaravelli inspired yoga news, events and interesting articles here at the Intelligent Yoga Training Course (IYTT)

feeds.title: Yoga with Dora
feeds.description: Welcome, my name is Dora. I am living in the UK with my husband and 3 children. I am passionate about all things Yoga and Ayurveda. My life's mission is to introduce these wonderful systems to students, to help them nurture their body, mind, and spirit by clearly and compassionately guiding them through a yoga practice that is skillful, intelligent, and enjoyable.

feeds.title: Aura Yoga
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Geri and I began practising yoga in the early 1970's watching Lynn Marshall on TV. Yoga really is a 'Science for Life' that has and continues to sustain me. Yoga is an integral part of my life and I'm passionate about practising and teaching Yoga. I aim to always keep my classes welcoming, relaxed and fun. The main objective is not to tie yourself in knots but to 'un-tie' them.

feeds.title: All Yoga Training » Yoga Teacher Training Tips
feeds.description: Here you will find the best tips on how to become a better yoga teacher. From yoga itself to business advice, here you will find exclusive tips and secrets! All Yoga is a worldwide community of Yoga Instructors, practitioners and schools offering Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga Teacher Training and Yoga Alliance Instructor Certification Courses.

feeds.title: Sarra Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Sarra Yoga Blog teaches about Creating Health & Well-being with Iyengar Yoga. As a certified Iyengar® Yoga Teacher Sarra is qualified to teach at Junior Intermediate Level 3 or the new Level 3, which represents more than 8 years of professional training.

feeds.title: Laura Gilmore Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Laura Gilmore Yoga Blog provides articles about movement, mindfulness & meditation for mental, physical & spiritual health. Laura's personal practice and therapeutic process extends back over 30 years and continues to evolve. Laura's teaching is infused with this deep awareness of our common humanity, her unique, trauma sensitive approach is playful, creative and filled with kindness- with plenty movement challenges!

feeds.title: Elite Pilates Teacher Training Blog
feeds.description: Our Pilates & Yoga health blogs will help you on the road to becoming a Pilates teacher trainer in the UK. Elite Pilates Teacher Training is the Best Pilates Teacher Training in UK. We help aspiring Yoga & Pilates teachers become qualified instructors.

feeds.title: YogaVenue Blog
feeds.description: Get a better understanding about Yoga with the YogaVenue Blog. YogaVenue was founded by Caroline and Alessandro Gozzi 10 years ago to bring the practice of yoga to the city of Oxford. We've evolved over the last decade to help keep you on your mat wherever you are in the world and teach you how to share your love of yoga with others.

feeds.title: Yoga with Tash
feeds.description: Yoga and wellness blog, covering topics from meditation to mantra. I am Tash and I am here to make yoga more accessible to you, wherever and whoever you are! I have been practicing yoga for 10 years and love bringing yoga and its benefits into people's lives. I have taught for the past 3 years in some of the best studios and retreat centres around the world.

feeds.title: Catherine Annis Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Catherine Annis brings you all the resources you need to begin your yoga journey. Find out about her workshops, updates and much more through her blog. Catherine Annis is well known for her imaginative and practical approach to yoga. In 2017 she created the Intelligent Yoga Teacher Training Course (iytt), an 18 month, anatomically focused teacher training course with world-leading teachers such as Gary Carter.

feeds.title: Good Times Yoga Blog
feeds.description: This Blog gives a view of yoga from a student's point of view! That's me! I have been teaching since 2012 but always learning. I love being part of the yoga world. I write about the top teachers, yoga shows, festivals, studios and workshops, and the promise of yoga's self discovery. In this blog I include retreat information, workshop recommendations and Yoga In The News.

feeds.title: ZenMuma Blog
feeds.description: Visit our blog for regular news and updates about everything ZenMuma and ZenKids. Here we'll cover topics such as hypnobirthing, inductions, baby, new motherhood, toddlers, kids yoga, teen mindfulness, breathing techniques, asanas and more. ZenMuma is a worldwide community, providing support for pregnancy, birth, baby, children, teens and mums.

feeds.title: LIT Yoga Blog
feeds.description: LIT Yoga Blog explains about the uses of yoga for hypermobility and various areas of pain like muscles and joints. I'm Miriam Zendle. I'm a body positive yoga teacher who believes that yoga is for every body and every mind. If you've ever felt like yoga isn't for you, I'm here to help. In April 2018, I set up LIT Yoga, which stands for 'Loving, Inclusive, Transformational Yoga'.

feeds.title: JAMES RUSSELL YOGA Blog
feeds.description: James' blog includes articles on a range of yoga subjects such as ashtanga, hatha, kriya, philosophy, yoga practice, cultural appropriation and more. James is a yoga teacher, blogger and student. He's been practising yoga in one shape or form for over 23 years. He's currently studying at SOAS, University of London, for an MA in Yoga and Meditation.

feeds.title: Thrive with Embodied Wisdom Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Trauma-informed Yoga, Somatics Teacher, Teacher Trainer, Somatic Coach, Yoga Business Mentor and more with Thrive with Embodied Wisdom Blog. I'm Aneta Idczak and I love leading Transformational Somatic Yoga coaching and Yoga programmes, circles and retreats, as well as trauma informed Yoga teacher training and mentoring courses.

feeds.title: The Yoga Revolution Blog
feeds.description: The Yoga Revolution Blog is your source for yoga guides and resources. Find lessons for beginners, and yoga classes for all in the blog. Chloe, the founder of The Yoga Rev', started practicing yoga with online tutorials, and when she finally started going to in-person classes, they just didn't match up with her vision of how they should've been. So, she decided to train to become a teacher herself.

feeds.title: Re:Connect Blog
feeds.description: Re:Connect's blog explores yoga, mental health and well being themes. Our mission is to share the therapeutic benefits of yoga to support people to improve their health and wellbeing. We design and deliver yoga courses to empower individuals to improve their wellbeing and support a range of physical and mental health conditions.

feeds.title: Rest Yoga
feeds.description: A monthly yoga blog filled with insights and yoga and meditation practices that have worked for me and my students to solve specific issues. Get inspiring tips on how to take better care of yourself through the practice of yoga, meditation, journaling, and many other self-care routines. Elumi Yoga's blog shares Eliza's personal experiences and how she utilizes practices to help her grow and take better care of herself.

feeds.title: Natalie Cristal Morrison Blog
feeds.description: Natalie is a yoga teacher, meditation guide, health coach, and advocate for social change for the well-being of society and the environment. Her approach blends ancient and contemporary practices that cultivate our vitality, mental and physical awareness and our connection with the world

feeds.title: New Energy Yoga
feeds.description: Covers all the latest news from the studio from our Yoga teachers. New Energy Yoga Blog is dedicated to delivering an authentic yoga experience in an inspirational setting that is open and welcoming to all.

feeds.title: Wild Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The Wild Yoga blog is a place where you can read yoga and thought by Theo Wildcroft. My name is Theodora Rebecca Wildcroft and I'm a yoga teacher based in north Wiltshire working for a more sustainable relationship between our many selves, the communities that hold us, and the world that nourishes us.
